guide.title: What are the two factors?
guide.oi: OI (60 pts) — open interest against price, as four quadrants. OI up with price up means fresh longs, the best case for a long; OI up with price down means fresh shorts. Both falling-OI quadrants score low for either side — no new money is behind the move.
guide.cvd: CVD (40 pts) — cumulative taker buy minus sell. Half the points are direction, half are divergence: price falling while CVD rises means someone is absorbing, the strongest long signal; price rising while CVD falls is distribution.
guide.alert: An alert fires when one of the six scenarios is detected, locking the price at that moment. A changed scenario replaces it immediately; a scenario that disappears closes only after three consecutive scans without it — that buffer is what stops it retriggering as pivots confirm. The score only sorts the table; it never triggers an alert.
